<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 179.0946. Assuming this is the protonated molecular ion [M+H]⁺, the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 179.0946 – 1.0073 = 178.0873 Da. The formula that matches this mass best is C₇H₁₄O₅ (exact mass = 178.0841 Da, within typical instrument tolerance). No other heteroatoms are indicated, so the formula is simply C7H14O5.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H14O5</final_answer>
